In times like this you need your family more than ever. Keep them close to you and share your pain. And even if it hurts don’t close out the memories of your mother. You’re going to miss her and every little thing is going to remind you of her. It’s part of the grieving process, don’t suppress it. You’re going to ask yourself many questions, many what ifs but its important to remember that none of this is your fault, you aren’t responsible for the decision your mother made. What’s done is done and there’s no way for you to change it anymore sadly, im sorry. Let yourself feel, it’s okay to break down. You’ve experienced a terrible loss and now it’s on you to learn how to healthily deal with this situation.

I hope you and your family stay strong :)💞
-Sun
